<!-- pr-reviewer: 5592a073c7bb26db576cc7d674e6c97742d8ef3e -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Test-only PR (one test file plus a decision note); no product code changed.

**What looks good**
- Trial merge with current main (2bc79a3c, includes #1213) is clean; git auto-merged `lathe_workholding_mill_post.rs`, no conflict.
- All 9 formerly skipped cells now assert creation refusal by message (`a Facing operation is turning work ... mount a lathe (or a mill-turn) first`; `a Face operation is milling work ... mount a mill (or a mill-turn) first`). The test fails if a refused cell becomes creatable, or a creatable one gets refused, or the message changes.
- New pin `a_milling_section_on_a_plain_lathe_is_judged_by_the_chuck` reaches the `work_speed` plain-lathe milling arm via `program_problems_by` (8000 over a 2000 chuck is named, exactly at the limit is clean), and also pins that the post refuses the same section first by the family clause.
- No assertion weakened: every previous verdict assertion is kept; `doc` returning `Result` just carries the refusal text.
- Body has Changelog: none, Fixes #1215; decision note present.

**Local results merged with main**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test lathe_workholding_mill_post`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test lathe_workholding_mill_post -- -D warnings`: clean.

**24 cells (expectation from `judged()` on merged main = #1191 + #1213; "judged" = refused by the workholding maximum)**
| machine | turning post | milling post | undeclared post |
|---|---|---|---|
| none / mill - Work | refused at creation | refused at creation | refused at creation |
| none / mill - Tool | not judged | not judged | judged |
| mill-turn - Work | judged | judged | not judged (door refuses by name) |
| mill-turn - Tool | not judged | not judged (posts at chuck limit) | not judged (door refuses by name) |
| lathe - Work | judged | judged | not judged (door refuses by name) |
| lathe - Tool | refused at creation | refused at creation | refused at creation |

All 24 asserted (15 by verdict, 9 by creation-refusal message). Observed output matches each expectation and the #1213 rule (undeclared on chucked machines: door refusal naming the missing `capabilities = 2;` line, still asserted).

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. PR #1265 will flip the mill-turn / milling post / Tool cell (and `a_mill_turn_milling_section_through_a_milling_post_is_not_judged`); whichever merges second updates that expectation in `judged()`.
2. For a `none` (no machine) setup the refusal reads "the setup's machine is a mill" - already noted by the author as a polish candidate.
3. The file keeps its existing style (author notes it is not rustfmt-clean upstream either).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
